text:
maria_sales: FYI — VectorCorp POC hit a hard stop during today's demo. Sending a multi-doc request to generate a consolidated summary returns 413 from our edge and the AI output is truncated. Need quick workaround before the next call.

alex_s: Ugh. Do you have the failing request payload size or a curl? 413 usually gateway reject. Might be nginx or api-gateway limit.

maria_sales: Here's the curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-4x","input":"<very long text concatenation of 25 PDFs base64'ed>","max_tokens":2048}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large

nina_sol: They pasted whole PDFs into the JSON body, base64 included? That explains it. Also expensive token-wise.

david_eng: From runtime side, model couldn't even see the body because edge returned 413. Our logs show: 
```
edge-gw[12]: client_max_body_size exceeded: client intended to send too large body
```
We default to 4MB at the proxy layer for hosted API.

alex_s: Two quick options: 1) change flow to presign + upload to S3 then send a small manifest (we can fetch inside workflow), or 2) chunk content and send incremental retrieval queries (embed + retriever) so tokens are limited.

maria_sales: Customer prefers single request for the demo. They want a short script. Any stopgap we can do without infra changes?

oscar_support: You can gzip the payload client-side and set Content-Encoding: gzip. Our gateway accepts compressed bodies (but note Lambda/runtime needs to decompress). Also multipart/form-data uploading with streaming is an option — we accept chunked transfer.

nina_sol: If you gzip, remind them to set Content-Encoding: gzip and not encode files as base64 inside JSON. That usually drops body size a lot.

alex_s: Also, for demos we can recommend sending only text snippets and provide a retrieval demo: 
- Precompute embeddings on the large docs (hosted embedding endpoint)
- Store vectors in the customer's DB or a small demo vector store
- For each user query, retrieve top-k and send as context (<= 2-3 chunks).
This keeps generation request small and predictable.

maria_sales: They asked about token limits — will the model still truncate context?

david_eng: Model has a context window cap. For rwd-4x it's ~32k tokens (depending on quantization). But API also enforces a per-request token cap we set on the proxy to avoid runaway bills. For the hosted tier we clamp tokens + body size.

alex_s: Practical steps for the customer now (least friction):
1) Re-run demo but replace base64 blobs with gzipped text, set Content-Encoding: gzip.
2) If still hits 413, do chunked upload (Transfer-Encoding: chunked) or presigned upload then call a small /ingest endpoint that references the S3 key.
3) For long-term, demo retrieval flow with embeddings.

maria_sales: Can you share a minimal curl that uses gzip? I can hand to them now.

oscar_support: Sure: 
```
echo -n "$(cat concatenated_text.txt)" | gzip -c | curl -X POST 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' 
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' 
  --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate?model=rwd-4x
```
Note: server will decompress automatically.

nina_sol: Also mention pricing to VectorCorp: sending whole PDFs expands token count — we should offer a suggested POC design so they don't burn credits. I'll draft a short note.

maria_sales: Thanks. One more: they reported intermittent 429s when retrying after the 413. Possible race?

david_eng: If client retries aggressively after immediate 413 it can trigger rate limits or burst throttles at edge. 413s shouldn't retry — advise client to back off and switch to compressed/upload flow.

oscar_support: We'll also whitelist their demo IP for one hour if you want to bump limits temporarily for the call. But that's a manual support action (requires SOC approval).

maria_sales: Could we do the whitelist for 1 hour? Demo is in 35 minutes.

alex_s: I can escalate — pinging @sre_bot to open a rapid support task.

sre_bot: support-ticket-4567 created -> Escalation: Demo IP whitelist request for VectorCorp. Assigned to eng-oncall. ETA 20m. :rotating_light:

maria_sales: Amazing. I'll forward the gzipped curl and the embed-retrieval suggestion to them now. If eng needs logs, share the demo session id 82bf2.

david_eng: Noted. If whitelist goes through, we can temporarily raise client_max_body_size to 50MB for that IP. Post-demo we'll revert.

oscar_support: Follow-up: send the customer a sample presign flow if they want a single-call UX later. I can paste a minimal presign snippet after the demo.

maria_sales: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will update after the call. :thumbsup:
